[Leaders.Leader-0].Name: [Groups.soldiers.Mercenary].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! The government has taken control of Limansk, but quickly lost contact with units in the city. The commander, with support from his fighters, decided to desert and form a new faction, which most former fighters immediately joined. Dissenters were sent to feed the fish. Plans were drawn up, key routes were targeted for enrichment, but soon a powerful Emission struck and Limansk became a "closed" city once again. The deserter fighters were never seen again...
